text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Arima Kinen. Who will
be the
victor—Хиши Амадзон, or Narita
Brian? Or will it
be someone else
entirely from the elite lineup?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон gathers her focus with a
deep, long
breath. Her long-awaited
match with Нарита Брайан
is finally
beginning!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
